cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've ordered this replacement dinner. Why I missed our anniversary belongs in a calendar review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're sitting here now. Explain before dessert.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One item at a time, please. This booking is for dinner; we haven't arranged the review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cancel dessert. There, now we have time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell the waiter before you call it cancelled. We need that confirmed on the bill before I can open the calendar question.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 separates dinner booking from review and A5 corrects proposed versus completed cancellation, using professional sequencing to avoid an intimate question.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 timing request produces booking exclusion; B4 creates time by cancelling dessert; A5 requires actual waiter/bill confirmation.

relationship.evidence: B2/B4 show a partner trying to obtain an overdue explanation, not an arbitrary process question.

heightening.evidence: A5 converts B4 offered solution into the next unfinished administrative item.

specificity.evidence: A1 now states an ordered replacement dinner and anniversary; cancellation has a coherent object.
